action_description: Retiled only the GEMM2/down-projection FP4 dequant path: added an aligned I-tile microkernel for 32-element FP4 scale blocks using 128-bit streamed packed-weight loads, vectorized scale loads, branchless E2M1 nibble decode, and evict-last vector loads for the reused mid tile, with scalar fallback for unaligned or non-32 scale-vector cases. Expert grouping, GEMM1, and finalize logic are unchanged.
